messages:
eli: FYI saw a spike of fncall 'invalid_shape' events on orders-ingest this morning. console shows big red errors but the tool returned an array not an object. product is alarmed.
sam: can you paste a short example?
eli: validator log: expected object at top-level, got array -> sample='[{"line":1,"qty":2}]'
nina: note we rolled stricter fncall validation to a small canary last night. fallback routing (to cheaper model) is enabled for rejects.
praveen: current system: billing = final_model_id (where it executed). observability increments validation_reject on the origin route. so charges and error counts don't match and product is confused.
eli: proposed console change: introduce "soft-fallback" (amber) state for validation->fallback flows. show origin_route + billed_model + a redacted sample and link to trace.
sam: telemetry: emit tags fallback_reason, origin_route_id, execution_model_id, coercion_applied, counted_for_billing. add metric soft_fallback_rate.
nina: policy: add per-route fncall_shape_policy = strict|soft|coerce; default enterprise=soft. coerce lets adapter wrap array -> {items: array} before validation.
praveen: rollout tweak: exclude soft/coerce events from auto-flip triggers. auto-flip should only react to fatal rejects and capacity faults.
eli: action items:
 - T1: telemetry tags + soft_fallback_rate metric (sam)
 - T1: console soft-fallback UI + sample popover (nina)
 - T2: validator reason codes + suggested_coercion hint (praveen)
 - T2: adapter optional coercion + per-route flag (sam)
 - T2: billing wording + FAQ (nina + finance)
ops-bot: deploy 1751233000-fncall-validator-canary -> success (canary)
eli: if anyone sees >8% soft-fallback on a route before we ship, paste top 3 samples here and ping @eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
